rigor.basis: Quantifiers, basis definitions, rank-nullity Level-1 emptiness, weak SDP duality soundness over Q, and the exact boundary between Lean 4 formalization and Layer-2 exact-Q certificate replay are stated transparently and proved without gaps.

significance.basis: Resolves four concrete foundational questions on exact certification, polyhedral structure, NPA hierarchy tightness, and white-noise robustness across the normal cone NQ(p*), clarifying where normal-cone perturbations can and cannot improve device-independent protocols.

summary: Building on Wu, Xie, and Ramanathan (arXiv:2611.27413, 2026), this paper resolves the algebraic, polyhedral, NPA-hierarchy, and white-noise visibility structure of the three-dimensional normal cone NQ(p*) on ext(Q2222). It establishes four main results: (1) a dense rational parameterization k -> (alpha(k), beta(k)) placing p*(k), {I_alpha, S_alpha, D_alpha}, and all normal-cone vertices in Q, plus an exact two-square Z[alpha] identity I_alpha^2 + Q_alpha^2 ≡ (8 + 2*alpha^2)I (Theorem 3.1); (2) an exact octagon-to-hexagon facet transition of P(k) at the Tribonacci constant k_trib ≈ 1.839287 governed by det M(k) = 2*D^2*(k^3 - k^2 - k - 1) (Theorem 3.3); (3) a sharp 1D collapse of the N3-free subspace S4 onto conv{I_alpha, B_Bob(alpha)} contrasted with 2D inflation upon restoring N3, alongside an unconditional exact-Q four-tier separation ∅ = N_SOS^(1) ⊊ N_SOS^(1+AB) ⊊ N_SOS^(2) ⊊ NQ(p*(2)) via Level-1 rank-nullity, weak SDP duality, and rational LDL^T/SOS certificates (Theorem 3.4); and (4) an explicit four-vertex rational LP dual proving I_alpha uniquely minimizes white-noise visibility v(B) across NQ(p*(k)) (Theorem 3.5). All theorems, equations, and table entries verified in the PDF are sound and mutually consistent, with only two minor prose slips and no material objections.
weaknesses: In the proof of Theorem 3.3 (page 6), the 48 rational evaluations of the 8 non-facet local vertices at the 6 upper candidate vertices are summarized by sign/factor structure rather than printed explicitly or included in the Lean 4 kernel (which only checks the concurrency determinant).

The non-commutative word reduction and exact-Q LDL^T moment matrix replays for the 13 certificates are performed in a standalone Python verifier (Layer 2) rather than inside Lean 4 itself, though the manuscript documents this formalization boundary transparently.
In Theorem 3.5, the statement restricts k to Q ∩ (1, 1 + sqrt(2)), even though the four-vertex LP dual proof on page 9 holds verbatim for all real alpha in (0, 2) without requiring rationality.

The curved boundary contours and area percentages (80.0% and 97.9%) in Experiment 3 / Figure 1(a) rely on 36-angle numerical Clarabel SDP sweeps, unlike the discrete exact-Q witnesses establishing the strict chain (34).
